ns2:section.sectionText: COMM 391--Understanding and Producing New Media Provides students both a theoretical and practical understanding of new media. Studies the history and foundations of digital audio and video, network technologies and the Internet in order to develop a better understanding of the limits and possibilities of new media. These concepts are applied in hands-on demonstrations and assignments in producing new media, such as streaming audio and video on the web, CDs and DVDs. No prior production experience is expected or required.
